title: 大阪杯の後に・“1番”にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet comes within a hair's breadth of winning the Osaka Hai, but falls short of first place. Vodka, who has briefly returned to Japan, challenges her to a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two will battle it out at the autumn Tenno Sho, a race that holds the highest of honors for senior racers.
